def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Find the full row or column that separates the two patterns.
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        if len(set(row)) == 1 and h > 1:
            sep = r
            a, b = grid[:sep], grid[sep + 1:]
            base = next(v for v in a[0] if v != row[0])
            marker_a = next(v for v in set(sum(a, [])) if v != base)
            base_b = next(v for v in set(sum(b, [])) if v != row[0])
            marker_b = next(v for v in set(sum(b, [])) if v != base_b)
            return [[3 if a[i][j] == marker_a and b[i][j] == marker_b else base
                     for j in range(w)] for i in range(len(a))]
    for c in range(w):
        if all(grid[r][c] == grid[0][c] for r in range(h)) and w > 1:
            sep = c
            a = [row[:sep] for row in grid]
            b = [row[sep + 1:] for row in grid]
            base = next(v for v in set(sum(a, [])) if v != grid[0][c])
            marker_a = next(v for v in set(sum(a, [])) if v != base)
            base_b = next(v for v in set(sum(b, [])) if v != grid[0][c])
            marker_b = next(v for v in set(sum(b, [])) if v != base_b)
            return [[3 if a[i][j] == marker_a and b[i][j] == marker_b else base
                     for j in range(len(a[0]))] for i in range(h)]
    return grid

from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    # Locate a uniform separator row or column.
    sep_row = next((r for r, row in enumerate(grid)
                    if len(set(row)) == 1 and h > 1), None)

    if sep_row is not None:
        a, b = grid[:sep_row], grid[sep_row + 1:]
        ca = Counter(x for row in a for x in row)
        cb = Counter(x for row in b for x in row)
        bg_a, bg_b = ca.most_common(1)[0][0], cb.most_common(1)[0][0]
        mark_a = next(x for x in ca if x != bg_a)
        mark_b = next(x for x in cb if x != bg_b)
        return [[3 if a[i][j] == mark_a and b[i][j] == mark_b else bg_b
                 for j in range(w)] for i in range(len(a))]

    sep_col = next((c for c in range(w)
                    if all(grid[r][c] == grid[0][c] for r in range(h)) and w > 1), None)
    if sep_col is not None:
        a = [row[:sep_col] for row in grid]
        b = [row[sep_col + 1:] for row in grid]
        ca = Counter(x for row in a for x in row)
        cb = Counter(x for row in b for x in row)
        bg_a, bg_b = ca.most_common(1)[0][0], cb.most_common(1)[0][0]
        mark_a = next(x for x in ca if x != bg_a)
        mark_b = next(x for x in cb if x != bg_b)
        return [[3 if a[i][j] == mark_a and b[i][j] == mark_b else bg_b
                 for j in range(len(a[0]))] for i in range(h)]

    return grid

from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    # A solid vertical line separates equal-sized patterns.
    for c in range(w):
        if all(grid[r][c] == grid[0][c] for r in range(h)):
            left = [row[:c] for row in grid]
            right = [row[c + 1:] for row in grid]
            if c == 0 or w - c - 1 != c:
                continue
            counts = Counter(x for row in left for x in row)
            background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
            return [[3 if left[r][j] == right[r][j] else background
                     for j in range(c)] for r in range(h)]

    # For a horizontal separator, use the lower pattern's background.
    for r in range(h):
        if len(set(grid[r])) == 1:
            top, bottom = grid[:r], grid[r + 1:]
            if not top or not bottom:
                continue
            counts = Counter(x for row in bottom for x in row)
            background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
            return [[3 if top[i][j] == bottom[i][j] else background
                     for j in range(len(grid[0]))] for i in range(len(top))]

    return grid
